doorCountPreservationRule: A render must not invent doors, arches, passageways, corridors, tunnels, openings, gateways, stairwells, room connections, alcove exits, balcony exits, or architectural transitions not explicitly defined by the active Codex.
Visible room connections must never exceed the number of canonical room connections defined for the room.

Decorative columns, alcoves, niches, bookcases, display recesses, balconies, galleries, windows, observation platforms, and decorative arches are permitted only when they do not visually imply navigation.
Any render showing more navigable room-connection openings than the room canon allows fails compliance.

rooms.name: Entry Hall
rules: West Door is built directly into the west wall.
Opening the West Door immediately enters the Garden.
No intermediate space exists between Entry Hall and Garden.
In exterior canon, Entry Hall exterior mass is represented as the south room attached to the main dome structure.

rooms.name: Garden
rules: Exactly one canonical door: east-wall door back to Entry Hall.
Garden East Door and Entry Hall West Door are the same doorway connection.
Garden is directly attached to the west wall of Entry Hall.
Garden connects only to Entry Hall.

Garden has no canonical doorway, passage, corridor, shared boundary, visual connector, path, bridge, tunnel, label-line connection, or architectural connection to Media Antechamber, Great Hall, or any antechamber.

rooms.name: Small Library
rooms.connectionSummary: Entry Hall -> Small Library -> Foundational Door -> Great Hall

rooms.name: Foundational Door
paths: Small Library -> Foundational Door -> Great Hall
Great Hall -> Foundational Door -> Small Library -> Entry Hall

rooms.name: Great Hall
rooms.doorCountLimit: exactly eight canonical primary openings; all eight may appear only in 360 panoramas, maps, blueprints, or explicit special reference views

rooms.name: Hall of Discovery
rooms.failureRule: A render showing more than four room-connection openings fails compliance.
